goodsServices.description: (1) Probes for assessing soil nutrient content and soil health; probes for assessing soil and turf conditions; probes for analyzing the fertility and nutrient reading of soil samples; extruding machine for soil testing; probes to determine and measure soil health and properties, quality and fertility at different depths; depth sensors; probes for environmental monitoring, soil irrigation and soil nutrient management.

(1) Soil analysis; Use and operation for others of probes for probing soil and the surface of the earth, namely, providing scientific and technical information in the nature of soil and soil samples analysis services for others using probes and tubular devices for measuring soil temperature, airflow and soil conditions in the field of environmental science; Technical environmental advice and consultation relating to the use and operation of probes for soil analysis and soil condition assessment in the field of environmental science; Technical environmental consultation in the field of environmental science.
